_meta.title: East Java volcano corridor — operational field data (Surabaya–Bromo–Ijen–Ketapang)
_meta.purpose: Manual research layer that fills null distances/durations/rates in the generated itinerary-intelligence datasets. Cited, confidence-rated.
_meta.method: deep-research workflow: 23 sources, 112 extracted claims, 25 verified, 20 kept, 14 synthesized findings. Round 1 = fares/distances. Round 2 (pending) = ferry ops, Ijen rules, Tumpak Sewu access, Bromo hours.
_meta.confidence_scale: high = corroborated/primary or government regulation; medium = single decent source or operator consensus; low = weak/old/conflicting or gap
global_caveats: All fees/fares are post Oct/Nov 2024 regulatory updates; re-verify at booking time.
Many operator blog pages still display STALE pre-2024 Bromo fees (29k/34k domestic, 220k/320k foreign) — do not use.
Rome2Rio/Gecko algorithmic route times underestimate this mountain corridor; use operator durations.
Bromo/Ijen ticketing now online + cashless (QRIS at Ijen since 31 Jan 2025); ferry via Ferizy app.

road_legs.note: Rome2Rio 115.6 km. ~100 km via Wonokitri/Pasuruan, ~136 km via Probolinggo/Cemoro Lawang. Algo 1h35m is WRONG for ops. Operators depart midnight-1AM to reach Cemoro Lawang ~3AM for sunrise. Discard a stray 'straight-line 160 km' figure (implausible).

Drive 45-60min from Bromo; separate 20-30min (~1.5km) walk through canyon/shallow river to main falls. Helmets mandatory. One outlier cites up to ~1.5h drive in traffic. Walk time varies 15-40min by start reference.

Cemoro Lawang -> Paltuding via Probolinggo-Bondowoso/Sempol. dionjogjadriver 220-240km/6-7h; ijenvolcanotour 212.6km. REJECT Gecko 140km outlier (straight-line). Exact figure depends on endpoint (Paltuding vs Banyuwangi/Ketapang).

jeepbromo.com: ~7h, shared car/van IDR 295,000/pax, pickup 9-10am, drop at Banyuwangi accommodation. Competing shuttles ~350k/pax min 4 pax. The 35-40k/pax figure is ONLY the short Cemoro Lawang->Probolinggo green-minivan leg, not full corridor. REJECT Rome2Rio 3h25m.
CORRECTION: prior seed had 6-8h; research consensus is 4-5h via Surabaya-Probolinggo toll road. Source erctrans self-contradicts (3.5-4h body vs 5-6h FAQ); distance ~160km is solid.

bromo_logistics.viewpoint: Penanjakan 1 fills before sunrise, empties ~1h after

jeep_rates_idr.type: paguyuban (driver-cooperative), NOT official park rate, fluctuative by gate/season; excludes entrance tickets

ijen_trek.trail: ~3km one-way, ~25% incline, Paltuding base to crater rim

medical_check.document: Surat keterangan sehat (doctor health certificate), checked at barcode->hiking-ticket exchange
medical_check.on_site_option: From Feb 2025: Pos Kesehatan Pariwisata at Paltuding parking issues it on-site for IDR 20,000/person
medical_check.criteria: No asthma/heart disease history; physically + mentally fit; on-site checks BP (no hypertension), SpO2, height/weight
medical_check.enforcement_caveat: Oct 2024 reports of inconsistent on-the-ground enforcement; rule is official

gear_zone_sop.mask_rental_mandate: UNRESOLVED — mask use mandatory in inner zones, but whether RENTAL (vs own) is mandatory not settled

ijen_rules.local_guide_mandatory: UNRESOLVED — not confirmed mandatory under a specific BBKSDA rule (round 3)
ijen_rules.crater_exclusion: Even at Level I (Normal): no approach to crater rim, no descent into crater, no overnight within 500m of rim (1.5km at Level II)

volcanic_closures.authority_split: PVMBG/Badan Geologi/ESDM (via MAGMA Indonesia) sets ALERT LEVEL (1-4); BBKSDA Jatim issues operational TWA closure/reopening
volcanic_closures.event_2024: Closed 12/13 Jul 2024 -> reopened 8 Sep 2024 (~2 months). Level II Waspada from 12 Jul 22:00 WIB (NOT noon - Kompas typo), down to Level I Normal 13 Aug 13:00 WIB
volcanic_closures.annual_admin_closure: Brief early-Jan administrative evaluation closure (e.g. 3-6 Jan 2024); also election days
volcanic_closures.feb_2026: Radar Banyuwangi references TWA Kawah Ijen total closure 19-26 Feb 2026 (UNVERIFIED vs primary)
volcanic_closures.advice: Re-check MAGMA Indonesia / bbksdajatim.org before travel

ketapang_gilimanuk_ferry.note: Base regular fares; holiday/Nataru/mudik periods apply higher differentiated tariffs + longer queues. IVA 213,400 was prior decree; Class IV 225,000 is Nov 2024.

operations.duration_caveat: Apparent 2h is an artifact of WIB(Java)/WITA(Bali) 1h timezone shift, NOT real sailing time. Add dock queue/berthing.
operations.frequency: ~hourly round the clock; some sources cite every 20-30 min
operates_24h_exceptions: Balinese Nyepi full shutdown (2024-03-11 24h; 2025: Ketapang 28 Mar 17:00 WIB - 30 Mar 06:00)
operations.queue_time_status: no quantified peak/holiday wait figures verified — round 3

booking.go_show: ABOLISHED — no on-site purchase; ticketless vehicles turned away
booking.geofence_block: Cannot buy online within 2.65 km of Ketapang / 2 km of Gilimanuk (GPS-enforced) — MUST hold ticket before arrival
booking.effective: geofence rule 2023-12-11; reinforced mandatory at 4 main ports 2024-07-01
booking.ops_impact: Tour must pre-book ferry before staging at harbor; affects dropoff buffer + queue logistics

madakaripura.closure_triggers: Heavy rain -> flash flood + landslide; documented road collapse with injuries; 'enter at your own risk' sign during closures
madakaripura.rule_2pm: Exit canyon before afternoon tropical rains
madakaripura.monitoring: 24h water-level station, prompt evacuation when water rises

tumpak_sewu.closure_triggers: Rainy-season lahar/flash-flood in canyon (Semeru lahar feeds the river). Real fatal incidents documented.
